source: src_vs_code/package.json at P (af7f2856): precompile = pretypecheck = `npm run prepare:gate` (= node scripts/prepare-gate.mjs && node scripts/generate-security-lane.mjs); compile = `npm run clean && tsc -p ./`; typecheck = `tsc -p ./ --noEmit`; lint = `eslint src`; test = `npm run compile && node scripts/run-tests.mjs` (one `node --test` batch over every out/test/*.test.js, then each src/test/*.test.mjs in its own process). test:host / test:seam / test:contract are NOT used. tsconfig: rootDir src, outDir out, `noEmitOnError: true`, strict, noUnusedLocals/Parameters, exactOptionalPropertyTypes. Lockfile pins typescript 6.0.3, eslint 10.11.0, @types/vscode 1.134.0. Local node v24.18.0.

restore.resolvedBy: lib/commands.mjs toInvocation -> lib/proc.mjs npmInvocation: process.execPath + <dirname(process.execPath)>/node_modules/npm/bin/npm-cli.js (no shell; npm.cmd cannot be spawned without one)

prepareGenerated.requires: restore not needed; run before typecheck/compile in every scoring copy
prepareGenerated.why: prepare:gate runs `.agents/conventions/tools/rules.mjs check --repo <root>`, which (conventions bb022429, tools/lib/rule-cli.mjs:80-90) requires the mount to be a git checkout whose HEAD equals the outer index's gitlink and has no uncommitted changes, CLAUDE.md to be exactly '@AGENTS.md', and the conventions' own node_modules. A cell tree (archive-extracted mount, fresh `git init`, arm overlay written into the mount) fails every one of those, so `npm run compile`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` FAIL in a cell at precompile — and prepareGate() deletes src/generated/gateRule.ts BEFORE the check throws.

compile.requires: prepareGenerated; delete out/ first (the npm script's `clean`)

lint.requires: prepareGenerated (type-aware rules, incl. @typescript-eslint/no-floating-promises — relevant to 2.2's unawaited stamp)

testAll.requires: compile first; node 24 expands the glob itself

testSources.requires: one process per file, as scripts/run-tests.mjs does; OPTIONAL
testSources.note: The 10 source tests at P are tests of scripts; prepareGate.test.mjs, claudeAdapter.test.mjs and theBundleLoads.test.mjs read the conventions mount / build the bundle and are expected to fail in a cell-shaped tree. Baseline them on the reference in the same environment or leave them out of the own-suite verdict.

notes: noEmitOnError is ON in this package (unlike the previous story): a materialised hold-out with a type error emits NOTHING, so `compile-error` is the verdict and there is no stale-but-runnable out/ to fall back on. Still delete out/test/<name>.test.js before compiling so a previous emit cannot stand in.

Own-suite baselining is mandatory here: several compiled tests at P read the conventions mount (featureSnippet, projectIdentity, questionSnippet, snippetDiscovery, snippetVersion, workflowGuards — the compiled test files at P that mention '.agents/conventions' or 'generated/'; not each verified to fail), and the arm overlay rewrites two mount files. Run the reference (P + S's diff) through the identical copy + prepareGenerated + compile + testAll pipeline and score a candidate's own suite as 'no NEW failure against the reference's failing set', not as 'zero failures'.

Cells (not this file's scope, but the same cause): an agent that runs `npm run compile` / `npm test` in a cell will hit prepare:gate's refusal and lose src/generated/gateRule.ts; whatever the harness does about it (keep a real submodule checkout at the pin with its node_modules and commit the overlay inside it with the gitlink moved, or pre-generate and accept the refusal) must be identical for both arms and probed BEFORE generation 1 — the previous pilot's generation 1 was voided by exactly this class of environment failure.

eslint at P is type-aware (`no-floating-promises`): a candidate that calls an async stamp from activate() without `void` or `.catch` is red on lint — that is the repository's own enforcement of 2.2, not a hold-out.
